# anchor meaning

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:anchorMeaning`](gmeow-anchorMeaning.md)

- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

What scores in this range MEAN — the calibration prose. NOT functional and range-open (review): localizable prose may carry one meaning per language tag (sh:uniqueLang, SHACL) — a French and an English calibration coexist; two same-language meanings do not. Mandatory: an anchor without a meaning is just an interval.
